dialogue.origin: 今日はよろしくお願いします。20時になりましたら始めさせていただきますね。
dialogue.content: Thank you for joining us today. We will begin at 8:00 PM.

dialogue.origin: はい宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。相談員です。はじめに　よろしければ　性別とご年齢をお伺いできますか。
dialogue.content: Good evening. I’m the counselor. To begin, if you’re comfortable, may I ask your gender and age?

dialogue.origin: はい50代女性です
dialogue.content: Yes, I’m a woman in my 50s.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなご相談でいらっしゃいますか
dialogue.content: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 中学生の娘が学校に行きたくないみたいで悩んでます
dialogue.content: I'm worried because my middle school daughter doesn't seem to want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。お嬢様のこと　もう少し　お話いただけますか
dialogue.content: I see. Could you tell me a little more about your daughter?

dialogue.origin: 友達とケンカした訳でもなくいじめられてもいないのに何故かわからないけど行きたくないと
dialogue.content: She hasn’t had a fight with friends and she isn’t being bullied, but for some reason she says she doesn’t want to go.

dialogue.origin: それはご心配でいらっしゃいますよね...
dialogue.content: That must be very concerning for you...

dialogue.origin: いつころから行きたくないとおっしゃっているのですか
dialogue.content: Around when did she start saying she doesn't want to go?

dialogue.origin: はい先生からもクラスのリーダー的な存在ですと聞いていたので
dialogue.content: Yes, I’d also heard from her teacher that she was something of a leader in the class, so...

dialogue.origin: 二年の三学期からです
dialogue.content: It started in the third term of her second year.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。クラスのリーダー的存在...活発なお嬢様なのでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. A leader in her class… Would you say she’s active and outgoing?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 2年の３学期から...今は中学３年生でいらっしゃいますか。
dialogue.content: Since the third term of her second year... Is she in her third year of middle school now?

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: That’s right.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。学校へ行きたくないとおっしゃる...そんななか登校はされているのですか。それともお休みされていますか。
dialogue.content: I see. She says she doesn’t want to go to school… In that situation, is she still attending at all, or has she been staying home?

dialogue.origin: たまに行く感じで休む事が多いです
dialogue.content: She goes occasionally, but she’s absent most of the time.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、お休みすることが多い...お母さまとしてはずっと心配されてこられているのですよね。
dialogue.content: I understand. She’s often absent… As her mother, you’ve been worried all along, haven’t you?

dialogue.origin: そうですね友達も迎えにきてくれるのに部屋から出てこないので
dialogue.content: That's right. Her friends even come to pick her up, but she won't come out of her room.

dialogue.origin: 部屋から出てこない...そうですか。なんとかしてあげたい気持ちになってしまいますよね...
dialogue.content: She won’t come out of her room… I see. It makes you want to do something to help her, doesn’t it?

dialogue.origin: もしよろしければお母さま（あなたさま）のお気持ちもう少し聞かせていただけますか。
dialogue.content: If you're comfortable, could you tell me a little more about how you're feeling as her mother?

dialogue.origin: はいご飯は食べに出てくるので近くにはいてます
dialogue.content: Yes, she does come out to eat, so she is nearby.

dialogue.origin: そうですね私の育てかたが間違ってたのかなと思ったり
dialogue.content: Well, I sometimes wonder if my parenting was wrong.

dialogue.origin: 娘を見てなかったのかなと反省したりです
dialogue.content: And I reflect, thinking maybe I wasn’t really seeing my daughter.

dialogue.origin: ええ..ご自身を責めたくなるようなお気持ちがおありなのですね...
dialogue.content: I see… It sounds like you’re feeling inclined to blame yourself…

dialogue.origin: そうですね仕事や趣味で家を空けることが多かったので
dialogue.content: That's right. I was often away from home for work and my hobbies.

dialogue.origin: そうでしか...お忙しくしていらっしゃるのですね　今はいかがですか。お嬢さんとお話できる時間などありますか。
dialogue.content: I see... It sounds like you've been very busy. How about now? Do you have time to talk with your daughter?

dialogue.origin: 話す時間はありますがあまり話したがらないです
dialogue.content: We have time to talk, but she doesn't seem to want to talk much.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。お母さまとしてはもっと気持ちを話してもらいたいですよね...
dialogue.content: I understand. As her mother, you wish she would open up more about her feelings...

dialogue.origin: そうですね何か原因があるのか聞いても何もないけど行きたくないと
dialogue.content: That's right. Even when I ask if there's a reason, she just says there's nothing, but she doesn't want to go.

dialogue.origin: 何が原因かわからないというのが、ますます不安にもなりますよね...
dialogue.content: Not knowing the cause makes you even more anxious, doesn’t it?

dialogue.origin: 友達に合わすのに疲れたのかなと思って聞いたりもしましたが
dialogue.content: I thought maybe she was tired of trying to fit in with her friends, so I asked her about that, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 違うみたいで本当に難しいです
dialogue.content: Apparently that's not it. It's really difficult.

dialogue.origin: 難しい..ええ。　本当に　一番近く　大切なお嬢様なのに　わからない部分があって　とても苦しいですね...
dialogue.content: Difficult... Yes. She's your closest and most precious daughter, yet there are parts you don't understand, which must be very painful...

dialogue.origin: 少し整理してみてもよろしいですか。
dialogue.content: Would it be alright if I summarized things for a moment?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お嬢様が2年の3学期から　学校に行きたがらなくなり、お休みすることが多くなっている
dialogue.content: Starting from the third term of her second year, your daughter has become reluctant to go to school and is often absent.

dialogue.origin: お友達が誘いに来てくれても部屋から出てこない。食事のときは出てくるけれど、あまり話をしたがらない
dialogue.content: Even when friends come to pick her up, she won’t come out of her room. She comes out for meals but is reluctant to talk much.

dialogue.origin: 学校へ行きたくない理由が　わからず　お母さまもとても心配して過ごされている　という状況ですね。
dialogue.content: And because the reason she doesn't want to go to school is unknown, you, as her mother, have been very worried. That is the situation, correct?

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: That’s right.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。今日は、このお時間をどのように使いたいとお考えですか。お母さまのお気持ちをもうすこしお話いただいてもいいですし、これからどのようにしたらお母さまのお気持ちが少し楽になるかご一緒に考えてみましょうか。
dialogue.content: Thank you. How would you like to use this time today? We could talk more about your feelings as a mother, or we could think together about what might make you feel a bit more at ease going forward.

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫ですもう自分で考えようと思いますありがとうございました
dialogue.content: I’m okay. I think I’ll figure it out on my own now. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。今なにが起きていらっしゃいますか。こちらのやりとりでは難しいようにお感じになりましたか。
dialogue.content: I see. What is happening for you right now? Did you feel that this exchange wasn’t helpful for you?

dialogue.origin: すみませんこれは離脱になりました。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, this has become a disengagement.

dialogue.origin: 承知いたしました。ご指摘お待ちしております。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Understood. I’ll await your feedback. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございましたまた後で評価を書かせて頂きますね
dialogue.content: Thank you. I will write up my evaluation later.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします。終了させていただきます。
dialogue.content: I look forward to it. I will now end the session.

topic.sub: 中学生の娘の登校意欲の低下
